map.n/Σ(1/x_i)，用于速率、均价等倒数平均。: n/sum(1/x_i), used for rates, average prices and other reciprocal averages.
map.等距离不同速度的平均速度。: Average speed for equal distances at different speeds.
map.调和均 ≤ 几何均 ≤ 算术均。: Harmonic mean <= geometric mean <= arithmetic mean.
map.：去 60 km/h、回 40 km/h（等距）：H=2/(1/60+1/40): : Going at 60 km/h and returning at 40 km/h (equal distance): H = 2/(1/60 + 1/40) = 2/(0.01667 + 0.025) = 2/0.04167 = 48 km/h (not 50).
map.由数值序列求平均绝对偏差: Mean absolute deviation from a numeric series
map.为何往返不是算术均？: Why is a round trip not the arithmetic mean?
map.慢速段耗时更长、权重更大，调和均按时间加权，正确反映总耗时。: The slower leg takes longer and carries more weight; the harmonic mean weights by time and correctly reflects total time.
map.调和均最小？: Is the harmonic mean the smallest?
map.是，对正数恒有 H≤G≤A，极端值（很小分母）拉低调和均。: Yes, for positive numbers H <= G <= A always holds, and extreme values (very small denominators) pull the harmonic mean down.
